work_packet_header.workstream: authenticated classical and quantum control branch
work_packet_header.capability_or_component: producer-specific bounded approximate inverse, derivative surrogate and Y/Z radii-polynomial proof ABI
work_packet_header.current_maturity: continuous operators, coefficient spaces and flat-carrier bounds defined; no scientific inverse constructed
work_packet_header.target_maturity: independently audited fail-closed inverse/radii definition suitable for disjoint fixture producers
required_evidence: synthetic pass, every first-failure class, corruption and chronology fixtures
stop_fail_criteria: a singular finite block or zero tail multiplier
constructing or changing A after any Y/Z or radius observation
a strict interval predicate touching its boundary
candidate evaluation, root creation, authorization or authority promotion
explicit_non_goals: requiring primary and independent producers to share a solver algorithm
executing endpoint, continuation or selected-member bounds
candidate execution, G3, quantum outputs or physical claims
work_packet_header.downstream_gate_unlocked: fixture implementations of the common inverse/radii record semantics after independent definition audit

mathematical_spaces.state_functions: canonical Chebyshev l1_8 sequences in the v2 component order plus the chart scalars
mathematical_spaces.first_order_residual_functions: canonical Chebyshev l1_6 sequences in the v2 row order
mathematical_spaces.second_derivative_auxiliary_residuals: canonical Chebyshev l1_4 sequences only where an explicitly named proof product requires two derivatives
mathematical_spaces.finite_rows: interface, origin, member and recurrence rows use the exact dyadic component norm 1
mathematical_spaces.product_norm: the maximum of all weighted function and scalar/finite-row component norms

encoded_operator_class.finite_cutoff: the frozen grid node count N for the applicable chart; the finite state and row sizes are exactly those in state/grid v2
encoded_operator_class.A_finite: an exact dyadic row-major square matrix mapping finite residual rows to finite state coefficients
encoded_operator_class.A_dagger_finite: an exact dyadic row-major square matrix mapping finite state coefficients to finite residual rows
encoded_operator_class.finite_bijection: A_finite must have a nonzero exact determinant certified by a fraction-free elimination transcript; row swaps and pivots are recorded
encoded_operator_class.tail_components: the eight function components only, coefficient ordinals k>=N
encoded_operator_class.A_tail: A maps residual basis e_(c,k) to gamma_c*(k+1)^(-ell_c)*state basis e_(c,k)
encoded_operator_class.A_dagger_tail: A_dagger maps state basis e_(c,k) to delta_c*(k+1)^(ell_c)*residual basis e_(c,k)
encoded_operator_class.tail_loss: ell_c=2 for every first-order ODE component; any future second-derivative auxiliary product must declare ell_c=4 in a separate role
encoded_operator_class.tail_multipliers: gamma_c and delta_c are nonzero exact dyadics, encoded in component order
encoded_operator_class.finite_tail_cross_blocks: zero in A and A_dagger; all actual finite/tail coupling is bounded in Z0 and Z1 rather than hidden in an unencoded action
encoded_operator_class.bounded_bijection: nonzero gamma_c plus finite invertibility make A a bounded bijection from the declared residual product space to the state product space

producer_specific_construction.shared_mathematics: only the encoded operator class, proof predicates and record ABI are common
producer_specific_construction.primary: future C++ producer constructs its dyadic finite matrices and tail multipliers using its separately hash-bound Arb/FLINT/GMP/MPFR-lineage algorithm
producer_specific_construction.independent: future pure-Rust producer constructs its own dyadic matrices and tail multipliers using separately hash-bound Rust source with no C arithmetic lineage
producer_specific_construction.same_proof_result_required: both must prove the same frozen mathematical cell/member duties and their accepted solution/observable balls must overlap under the later agreement ABI
producer_specific_construction.construction_definition_binding: each producer manifest must freeze its deterministic matrix-construction algorithm and work budget before any scientific execution

chronology.strict_rule: no byte of A, A_dagger, their certificates, algorithms or work budgets may change at or after Y_computed
chronology.retry_rule: a failed bound or absent passing radius is immutable evidence; no alternate inverse, tail multiplier, radius order, center, precision, output root or work budget is permitted within that execution
chronology.timestamp_rule: monotone integer event ordinals are authoritative; wall-clock strings are metadata only

bounds.Y: sup over the frozen parameter tube of norm(A*F(parameter,x_bar(parameter))), including every flat-carrier remainder contribution
bounds.Z0: norm(I-A*A_dagger), including finite, tail and declared cross-block majorants
bounds.Z1: sup over the parameter tube of norm(A*(A_dagger-D_xF(parameter,x_bar(parameter))))
bounds.Z2: an outward bound such that norm(A*(D_xF(parameter,x)-D_xF(parameter,x_bar)))<=Z2*norm(x-x_bar) throughout the largest preregistered ball
bounds.parameter_defect: all derivative and residual effects of an affine or higher-order center tube are included in Y or Z1 under the exact tube contract; omitted parameter terms fail
bounds.flat_remainder: the complete flat-carrier record is mandatory input to Y,Z1,Z2
bounds.nonnegative_finite: Y,Z0,Z1,Z2 must be finite outward balls with lower endpoint >=0

strict_pass: the complete ball remains inside every chart/domain/sign denominator margin
radii_decision.selection: the least j satisfying every predicate
radii_decision.failure: if no j passes, or any required interval is missing, invalid or undecidable, the proof role FAILS
radii_decision.touching: an upper endpoint equal to zero for p or equal to one for c does not pass
radii_decision.theorem: when A is a bounded bijection and all predicates pass, T=I-AF is a strict self-map contraction on the selected closed ball, giving one unique zero of F in that ball

record_abi.self_hash: canonical wire self-hash with the self-hash field omitted under the wire contract
record_abi.authority_rule: a fixture PASS cannot set scientific proof, candidate or physical authority

allowed: synthetic Y/Z pass and each strict-boundary fail
forbidden: constructing a matrix from a candidate Jacobian
